div.p: Licensed Medicare insurance agent and founder of ECOS Medicare Solutions, helping Arizonans make confident Medicare decisions.

div.div: Not connected with or endorsed by the U.S. government or the federal Medicare program. We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov, 1‑800‑MEDICARE, or your local State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) to get information on all of your options.

div.h2: Plain-English Medicare help, close to home
div.p: Darin Weidauer is a licensed Medicare insurance agent and the founder of ECOS Medicare Solutions. He helps Arizonans turning 65, people retiring and leaving employer coverage, and current beneficiaries who simply want to make sure their plan still fits — all in clear, everyday language, with no pressure.

Darin works with clients across the state from two offices — Mesa in the East Valley and Sun City in the West Valley. Whether you like to meet in person, talk by phone, or handle everything online, the goal is the same: help you understand your choices and pick coverage with confidence. Because agent help comes at no cost to you — plan premiums are the same whether or not you use an agent — there's no downside to asking questions.

From comparing Medicare Advantage, Part D and Medigap options, to timing your enrollment so you avoid lifelong penalties, to reviewing your plan each fall during Open Enrollment, Darin focuses on the decisions that matter most for your health and budget — and he'll always point you to free resources like Arizona SHIP when that's the better fit.

div.p: Third-Party Marketing Organization (TPMO) disclosure: This website is operated by ECOS Medicare Solutions and Darin Weidauer, a licensed insurance agent (National Producer Number 18580338), and is a Medicare marketing resource. We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227, TTY 1-877-486-2048), 24 hours a day / 7 days a week, to get information on all of your options.

This site is not affiliated with, connected to, or endorsed by the U.S. government, the federal Medicare program, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), or the Social Security Administration. Medicare has neither reviewed nor endorsed this information. Enrollment in a plan may be completed through the licensed agent or the linked self-service enrollment platform; you are never required to use an agent and may enroll directly through Medicare.

The educational information here reflects 2026 standard amounts published by CMS and is provided for general guidance only — it is not medical, legal, tax, or insurance advice, and your individual costs and options may differ. Always verify details with official sources before making decisions. Free, unbiased counseling is available from Arizona's State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) at 1-800-432-4040.
